blurb: We are conveniently located in Victoria, Illinois just 20 minutes from Galesburg and 55 minutes from Peoria and the Quad Cities. Our property features 5 lakes, full hookup RV sites, lakeside cabins, and a lovely Victorian rental house for our guests to enjoy. We also offer onsite fishing, hiking, boat ramps, a playground, and plenty of opportunities for rest and relaxation.
